reference.name: Target Style
reference.text: Relaunched as a dated premiere. The new @TargetStyle debuted at New York Fashion Week on 13 Sept 2025, tied to one named season, 'Forever Fall', with a fixed set of formats.

reference.name: Target SoHo
reference.text: The store as the feed: 'The Drop', a front zone that rotates monthly style collections, and 'Curated By', a guest-curated zone (opened 9 Dec 2025).

reference.name: Club Target
reference.text: Two creator tiers instead of one (May 2026): a gamified club for everyday fans, with weekly challenges, points and tiers, and invite-only Target Ambassadors, powered by LTK.

reference.name: Target by Design
reference.text: Its own design history as the event: a free two-day exhibition at the New Museum during NYFW, 10–11 Sept 2026, in three rooms: The Store, The Bag, The Archive.

reference.name: Inside Out
reference.text: The red bag as an owned object (Sept 2026): 'Red Bag Stories' creator hauls and 'Bagspotting' street activations in Boston and Chicago.

regulars_from: From Target: Club Target and Target Ambassadors, powered by LTK (May 2026). Two tiers replaced one programme because, in Target's words, creators "don't all operate the same way".
